name: agents-pixel-film
description: Agents — a 45-second pixel-art film for Pixel by Pixel (@p_by_p). Every frame and all music and sound effects are computed by code; the English narration is ElevenLabs TTS with burned-in pixel subtitles. English (main, narrated) and Russian (music only) versions.

scripts.qr: uv run --with opencv-python --with numpy python tools/qr_check.py out/film.mp4
